logic: An uploaded SVG signature of filled paths and its canonical JSON, the exact bytes stored as the signature's content (media type application/json), with their SHA-256, the digest a receipt names: StaxSignatureVectorParser reads the SVG and SignatureVector.canonicalJson writes the view box and the paths in a fixed key order, without whitespace, with absolute coordinates and every number rounded once to three decimals. The backend runs every case now (donations/infrastructure/signature/SignatureVectorSharedCasesTest). The browser never reads SVG; from 1.9 it runs the canonical-to-SHA-256 half and draws the canonical JSON, because it checks the served bytes against the receipt's digest before drawing them

cases.name: filled paths in a group with inherited fill and opacity

input.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 80"><g fill="#1D2A5C" fill-opacity="0.8"><path d="M12 60 C 30 8, 70 8, 90 60 S 150 110, 170 60 Z"/></g><path fill="#c0392b" d="M200 30 L230 70 Z"/></svg>
